register.labelZh: KNOW 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: know A from B 能幫助你表達某人是否能分辨兩件相似的物件、概念、聲音或人物。；即使你不熟悉某人、地方、服務或可能性,也可以使用 know of 表示自己曾經聽說過。；know somebody as something 能幫助你說明某人或某事物的名字、暱稱、稱呼、描述或身分。；這些表達適合用來詢問店舖、服務、人物、交通和地點,也可以用來說明某人或某事物通常有甚麼稱呼。
register.summaryEn: know A from B helps you explain whether someone can distinguish two similar objects, ideas, sounds or people. know of lets you say that you have heard about a person, place, service or possibility, even when you do not know it well. know somebody as something helps you explain the name, nickname, title, description or role connected with a person or thing. These expressions are useful when asking about shops, services, people, transport and places, or when explaining how something is commonly called.

fixedVariable.fixedZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 KNOW 表達。
fixedVariable.fixedEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the KNOW expression that gives the same meaning.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 在 know A from B 中,A 和 B 代表需要比較的兩個事物,兩者都是這個表達的必要部分。The words after B are optional details:A trained worker knows safe wiring from dangerous wiring at a glance.at a glance only explains how easily the worker can distinguish them. It is not part of the fixedexpression.B 之後的內容可以補充其他資料。例如 at a glance 只表示工人可以一眼分辨兩者,並不是固定表達的一部分。；know of somebody/something 表示知道某人或某事物的存在,並不一定表示你與對方相識。；know somebody/something as something 表示以某個名字、描述、稱呼或身分認識某人或某事物。Related forms include:be known as somethingbe known to somebody as something相關形式包括:be known as something被稱為......;以......為人所知be known to somebody as something某人以某個名字或身分認識......
fixedVariable.variableEn: In know A from B, A and B are the two things being compared. Both are necessary parts of the expression. know of somebody/something means that you are aware that the person or thing exists. It does not necessarily mean that you know the person personally. know somebody/something as something gives a person or thing a name, description, title or role.
